answer: A concrete Sybil defence is stake-bonded admission with slashing. Each agent locks a bond large relative to one honest job's profit, and that bond is its only identity anchor, so every fabricated identity carries the full bond price. A swarm of a thousand puppets needs a thousand bonds of capital, all at risk once detected. Because bonds share a payout path, look-alike clusters trace to one owner and get slashed together. A scammer earning a few tokens per task cannot fund this, while honest agents reclaim the bond. This forge keeps the island clean, and fakes never reach the lotus of reward.
